run_benchmark_multihead_attention: run a benchmark comparing original and xformers MultiheadAttention forward and backward pass performance
run_benchmarks: run benchmarks across all combinations of attention mask dtypes, key padding dtypes, and bias options
create_mask_tensor: create a random attention or key padding mask tensor with a specified dtype and shape
reset_random_seeds: reset PyTorch and Python random seeds to zero for reproducible benchmark results
compare_mha_implementations: compare original and xformers MultiheadAttention implementations using torch.utils.benchmark Timer and Compare
